name: Sweet Love Concerto
original_name: スイートラブコンチェルト
source:
Gentle-minded angel apprentice Michael (black hair, black skin) and strong-willed devil apprentice Rose (blonde hair, white skin) are in love relationship. Together they need to come through a number of life situations. In the first episode a human male appears who can pose a threat to this love link.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
性情溫柔的天使學徒米迦勒（黑髮、黑皮膚），與意志堅定的惡魔學徒羅絲（金髮、白皮膚）彼此相愛。兩人需要攜手面對生活中的種種境遇。第一篇中，一名人類男子出現，可能對這段愛情構成威脅。

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
